en: Colorized image of a historic multi‑story townhouse or small hotel with ornate stone façade and many green window shutters. Two small balconies with decorative wrought‑iron railings face a tree‑lined street and a garden terrace enclosed by a balustrade. Ivy climbs an adjacent building. Behind the houses rises a steep, forested hillside. The style evokes a Central European spa or residential district.
